findings: Neither implementation nor skill fully matches the raw original: original card fill is #50B1F9 alpha .12, not opaque #17294A or #182B4D.
Skill special card/input/table-hover/table-divider hexes have zero exact hex occurrences; dropdown #2E6086 is a real dropdown fill and swatch.
Color swatches preserve essential alpha values: card .12, divider white .1, border cyan .5, zebra dark .9/light .8, tags red .25 and orange/green/blue .2.
Both long business artboards use dark #121E37 base; Skill Light classification is not supported by these native layer fills. Color table title itself says Light Mode despite dark swatches.
Primary button default/hover/active/disabled and text levels match both implementation and skill; semantic hover/active swatches align Skill more completely than current implementation.
